FIELDS.NAME: TeleConnect Services
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: TeleConnect Services specializes in providing comprehensive answering and telemarketing solutions for small to medium-sized enterprises in various industries, including healthcare, retail, and finance. Our operations are conducted from secure, dedicated office spaces equipped with monitored alarm systems, ensuring the safety of our high-value telecommunications equipment. We facilitate both inbound and outbound calling services, employing trained staff who adhere to standardized scripts while ensuring compliance with the Telephone Consumer Protection Act (TCPA) and other relevant regulations. Our customer interactions are carefully monitored to maintain quality and regulatory adherence, while our CRM systems support data security and privacy. We emphasize proactive risk management practices, regular security assessments, and training for our employees on data protection to mitigate potential theft and vandalism risks. All automated communications are conducted with documented consumer opt-in, ensuring transparency and compliance with consumer protection laws.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On April 12, 2022, a data breach occurred due to a phishing attack, resulting in $1,000 in losses for customer notification and monitoring services. The issue has been resolved, and preventive measures have been implemented to enhance cybersecurity practices.
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM to 6:00 PM; Saturday, 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM; closed on Sunday.
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Safe Class: Class 2; Grade: Heavy Duty; Label: Telecommunication Equipment.
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Monitored security service on-site and an emergency response plan in place.
